simple.meaning: פְּרָזוֹן (pᵉrâzôwn) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “magistracy , i.e. leadership (also concretely, chieftains).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Judges, beginning at Judges 5:7. Its contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פְּרָזוֹן (H6520).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
